findings.evidence: REQ-060.2 requires installing from Chrome AND from Safari (Add to Dock) and opening in its own window. AC1-2 check the manifest and Chromium beforeinstallprompt only; the Safari path appears only in the description and AC3's apple-touch-icon mention. The AC would pass with a Safari-broken install.
findings.fix: Add AC: Given the built app in WebKit, When it is added to the Dock, Then it opens in its own window with the TLH icon and name 'TLH Trainer' (automated meta-tag check plus a recorded manual check); add AC that the installed app opens standalone without browser chrome.

findings.evidence: E13-S12 (ordinal 115000) sweeps Table Settings overlay, Settings with storage warning and reset dialog, which are built by E12-S03 (128000), E12-S09 (155000) and E12-S08 (141000), and Statistics states; it has no dependency edges to them and its note says 'include them as they land'. Its ACs cannot pass when it is built.
findings.fix: Add dependencies on E12-S03, E12-S08, E12-S09, E11-S01 and E05-S01 (or reorder it after them / split the sweep per screen into the owning stories' DoD).

findings.evidence: E13-S11 AC3 requires Statistics p95 <= 2.0 s with 100,000 hands, the work of E11-S12 (ordinal 150000); E13-S11 has ordinal 114000, no edge to E11-S12, and its note says 'its own story must be in place before this test runs'.
findings.fix: Add dependency on E11-S12 (and ordering after it) or remove AC3 and point to E11-S12#AC1.

findings.evidence: E13-S11#AC3 and E11-S12#AC1 both assert Statistics p95 <= 2.0 s with 100,000 hands [REQ-055.5].
findings.fix: Keep the measurement in one story; have the other reference it.

findings.evidence: E13-S02#AC4 injects an error while the Session Report or Statistics screen renders, which need E10-S01 (ordinal 58000) and E11-S01 (76000); E13-S02 has ordinal 55000 and direct deps only E02-S08 and E03-S11.
findings.fix: Add dependencies on E10-S01 and E11-S01 or move AC4 to a later story.

findings.evidence: E13-S07#AC2/AC4 need Statistics (E11-S01), Settings (E12-S01) and sit-and-go (E05-S01); E13-S09#AC1 needs a full session incl. Statistics and Settings. Direct deps list none of these; the notes say they are 'written in parallel'. Ordinals currently satisfy the order but the edges are missing.
findings.fix: Add dependency edges to E11-S01, E12-S01 and E05-S01.

summary: 25 clauses covered except REQ-060.2 (Safari install partial). Three hidden-dependency ordering defects (E13-S02, E13-S11, E13-S12) and missing edges for E13-S07/S09.
